title: Govern GitHub Copilot at Scale
description: A governance-at-scale briefing connecting GitHub policy, Copilot, GHAS, live demo transitions, and measurable operating practices.
audience: executives, platform, security, and engineering leaders
learningObjectives: Explain how enterprise, organization, repository, team, and identity boundaries fit together.
Assign ownership and decision rights for policy, repositories, teams, and exceptions.
Choose Copilot enablement tiers with data, permission, review, and evidence guardrails.
Connect rulesets and GHAS signals to a measurable SDLC operating model.
